description: A toothbrush, a small toothpaste tube with its cap, and a tall dark cup sit on the tabletop in front. The right hand reaches to the cup and pulls out the toothbrush as a right-hand object, while the left hand slides in to steady and pick up the toothpaste tube as a left-hand object; the left hand angles the tube nozzle over the toothbrush bristles and squeezes a dab onto them, then the right hand lifts the toothbrush and places it back into the cup.
